decisions.evidence: The captured roster records use LS in the same historical vocabulary as RS/S/FS/SS/LCB/RCB; matched PFR seasons resolve the players to DB. This is a source-native left-safety alignment label, not modern long-snapper evidence.
decisions.counterexample_policy: Do not apply outside 1950-1969 or to a different source dataset.

decisions.evidence: P is a real punter position on seasons declared P by PFR, but the same roster field is also present on multi-role players whose authoritative PFR primary declaration is QB/RB/WR/TE/DL. The raw source field is therefore retained and classified per player-season.
decisions.counterexample_policy: Never globally demote P or infer primary eligibility from roster-field presence.
